name: neural-weights-cjk
phase: Third functional graph: the v8-cjk-regs 8k run (Japanese + Korean + Taiwanese + Chinese under the 49-label head, Korean re-sourced from the 주소DB, three aligned registries), staged at cjk/v0.0.3/ on the Hugging Face bucket (#2204). Replaces the v8-cjk-kr graph (cjk/v0.0.2/).

format.model: ONNX fp32 (opset 18), inputs char_ids int64 (batch, sequence, 7) + attention_mask int64 (batch, sequence), output logits (batch, sequence, 49). No SentencePiece tokenizer: the encoder is one unit per Unicode code point with a ±3 character window over the sealed vocabulary in char-vocab.json (4,451 entries, <pad> 0, <unk> 1, code-point order).

files_md5.$comment: The candidate artifacts' md5s — what a materialized package is verified against.

training.run: v8-cjk-regs seed 42, 8,000 steps, batch 256, bf16, cosine, from scratch (corpus-python/src/mailwoman_train/configs/v8-cjk-regs.yaml); resumed from step-006000 after the first launch's client was killed
training.corpus: v8-cjk-regs-2026-09-08 overlay: the v8-jp-kana-2026-09-06 JP corpus (2,000,000 train rows, Overture-JP, five registers); the v8-kr-2026-09-08 Korean road-name address corpus rebuilt from the ministry's 2026-08 주소DB (2,000,000 train rows, seven registers incl. the lot-number form and the building name, 26 held-out 시군구); the v8-tw-2026-09-08 Taiwan corpus (2,000,000 train rows, Overture-TW, 15 of 22 縣市, five registers, 28 held-out 鄉鎮市區); three registries of typed business addresses aligned exactly against the LABEL keys before training — Korean permits (localdata-kr, 588,000 rows, 99.9% aligned), Japanese corporate numbers (houjin-jp, 588,000 rows, 88.3% aligned), Taiwanese companies (gcis-tw, 490,000 rows, 95.9% aligned); plus 126 CN organizational-unit rows. Source mixture overture-jp 0.34 / juso-kr 0.20 / overture-tw 0.20 / localdata-kr 0.09 / houjin-jp 0.09 / gcis-tw 0.06 / coarse-placer-cn-units 0.02; vocabulary re-sealed over the union

jp_board_20000.$comment: Held-out municipalities on the v8-jp-kana-2026-09-06 board, coordinate-acceptability at 15 km via the municipality centroid table (corpus-python/scripts/score_jp_probe_board.py --label-set stage3-cjk --all-municipalities), PyTorch read, the v8-cjk-kr base re-scored beside it on the same scorer. The kana_municipality register (1,127 rows) is unresolved by the kanji-keyed centroid table on both arms (1,125 gold-exact), which is why the blended number sits under the native register's.
jp_board_20000.note: かすみがうら市 (823 held-out rows) fails 0 on both arms; 中新川郡上市町 fails 42 of 130 (the base 124) — the corporate-registry rows carry the town whole often enough to move it, and the runtime's JP municipality register repair closes the rest (#2178). house_number reads 0.9901 against the base's 0.9924 (35 rows of 15,145), inside the 1 pp rule.

kr_board_20000.$comment: 26 held-out 시군구 on the 2026-08 주소DB board, seven registers (official, building, no_dong, postcode_first, short_region, unspaced, jibun); per-tag span exact-match with every same-tag span scored, PyTorch read (score_jp_probe_board.py --resolve-tags region,subregion --centroids kr-sigungu-centroids.json). Pre-registered bars: street and house_number ≥ 0.99, subregion ≥ 0.97, dependent_locality ≥ 0.95, region and postcode ≥ 0.99. The base reads region 0.9232 / subregion 0.9699 / dependent_locality 0.2076 / street 0.9179 on this board: it never saw the 2026 register names, the 읍/면 tier or the lot-number form.
kr_board_20000.note: Every bar clears. Coordinate acceptability carries the short_region register (2,047 rows, 강원 for 강원특별자치도) unresolved by the centroid key on every row, 2,045 of them gold-exact, and 화성시 (169 rows, all gold-exact) has no key in the table.

tw_board_20000.$comment: 28 held-out 鄉鎮市區 on the v8-tw-2026-09-08 board, five registers (official, no_village, spaced, no_region, with_unit); per-tag span exact-match, PyTorch read (score_jp_probe_board.py --resolve-tags region,subregion --centroids tw-district-centroids.json). First read; pre-registered bars: street and house_number ≥ 0.97, subregion ≥ 0.95, region ≥ 0.99. Tags: 縣市 → region, 鄉鎮市區 → subregion, 村里 → dependent_locality, 巷/弄 inside street, 之/樓 → unit.
tw_board_20000.note: Every bar clears. The no_region register (2,110 rows) is unresolved by the region-keyed centroid table on every row, 2,109 of them gold-exact.

registry_boards.$comment: Aligned rows of the held-out typed registry strings (KR permits 3,522, TW companies 8,164, JP corporate numbers 3,193); per-tag span exact-match, no bar on the first read. The base reads near zero on every tag it never saw.
registry_boards.kr: dependent_locality 0.9987, house_number 0.9994, subregion 1.0000, street 1.0000, unit 0.6993, venue 0.7307; coordinate acceptability 0.9165 (the permit rows carry coordinates)

cn_board_14.$comment: locality_unit span exact-match, PyTorch per-unit argmax.

model_lineage: 0.0.2: v8-cjk-kr step-024000 (fp32 ONNX md5 7a24dba39ee8b0a26aef62162b9fad3e, vocabulary 3,165 entries). 0.0.1: v8-cjk-full step-024000 (fp32 ONNX md5 e14ef4c426dabb22e9433ab04b584d48). Decision record: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-cjk-serving-path.md; receipts on #1176, #2034, #2164, #2184, #2204.
notes: One CJK package a consumer installs as a unit (#1177 Phase B): Japanese and Chinese ride one 49-label head; ja-jp and zh-cn data-only overlays follow.
Channel-free by contract (D5): no postcode-anchor, gazetteer, country or evidence channels; the graph declares only char_ids and attention_mask.

Korean rides the same head with no new tag: 시/도 → region, 시군구 → subregion (WOF counties), 읍/면 and 법정동/리 → dependent_locality (two spans when a row carries both), 도로명 → street, 건물번호 or the lot number → house_number, 우편번호 → postcode, the building name → venue (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-06-kr-under-the-cjk-package.md).

Taiwan rides the same head with no new tag: 縣市 → region, 鄉鎮市區 → subregion, 村里 → dependent_locality, the street with its 段/巷/弄 → street, 號 → house_number, 之/樓 → unit. No postcode field is built (Chunghwa Post's codes carry no distribution grant).

The three registries are typed business addresses aligned exactly against the LABEL keys before training; an unaligned string became a board row, never a training row (docs/records/evals/2026-09-08-v8-cjk-regs.md).
